title: Manager- Technical Support
jobDescription: Lead and mentor a team of Customer Support Engineers, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Own the end-to-end support operations, ensuring timely resolution of customer tickets while consistently meeting SLA commitments. Monitor ticket queues, prioritize critical issues, and ensure efficient workload distribution across the team. Act as the primary escalation point for complex customer issues and drive them to successful resolution with empathy and professionalism. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, QA, and Operations teams to resolve product issues and improve overall customer experience. Conduct regular reviews of support metrics, SLA performance, ticket trends, and customer feedback to identify improvement opportunities. Analyze recurring issues and work with internal stakeholders to implement preventive measures and process improvements. Develop and maintain support documentation, knowledge base articles, FAQs, and standard operating procedures. Support product releases by validating fixes, coordinating customer communication, and ensuring smooth rollout of updates. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance support processes, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction. Train, coach, and develop team members through regular feedback, performance reviews, and skill development initiatives. Prepare and present support performance reports, customer insights, and operational metrics to leadership.

title: Team Lead - Implementation
jobDescription: · Configure and implement the product in line with client requirements, while planning and managing project timelines and deliverables. · Create and maintain key documentation including design specs, unit test cases, KYC documents, and ensure proper source control usage across all projects. · Lead and manage a team of developers by providing technical guidance, internal platform training, and continuous skill development. · Conduct quality reviews of team deliverables, enforce coding best practices, and ensure thorough impact analysis before implementing changes in production systems. · Engage with customers through regular status updates and follow-ups to ensure project progress and alignment. · Drive continuous improvement by identifying enhancement opportunities, resolving defects, and ensuring progress towards zero QA shipment issues.

title: Project Manager – Implementation
jobDescription: Lead end-to-end project planning, execution, and tracking for platform implementations. Oversee project management, resource allocation, and scheduling to ensure timely delivery of high-quality results. Manage project scope, execution, and post-go-live monitoring, ensuring seamless transitions and project documentation. Proactively identify and manage project risks, providing regular updates to key stakeholders. Evaluate and assess project team performance, conduct regular reviews, and ensure alignment with project goals. Review design, development, and unit testing phases to ensure quality deliverables. Assign tasks to team members based on priority, availability, and skillset. Ensure thorough review of releases before UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and production deployment. Handle change requests and oversee project migration activities as required. Plan and execute deployments according to project needs and timelines. Stay up to date with Manage Artworks product suite and platform. Collaborate with the product development team to track and manage the delivery of new product features requested by clients.
